page.title: “する”から“される”へ視点移動

analysis.summaryJa: 受動態は出来事自体を変えず、行為を受ける対象へ視点を移す。能動文の目的語を受動文の主語へ置き、主語＋be動詞＋過去分詞で「〜される」を表す。時制・疑問・否定はbe動詞が担い、行為者が重要な場合だけby＋行為者を加える。
grammarPoints: 能動文の目的語を受動文の主語へ移すこと
主語＋be＋過去分詞の基本形
be動詞による時制・否定・疑問
不規則な過去分詞の使用
出来事を保った能動・受動の相互変換
visualEvidence: カメラがACTION DOERからRECEIVERへ向きを変えている
変換台が対象を主語のスポットへ移している
BEと過去分詞のブロックが受動の形を構成している
二組の能動・受動対比が出来事の同一性を示す
byの札が行為者を必要時だけ加えると示す
commonTraps: 受動文でbe動詞を落とす
過去形と過去分詞を混同する
能動文の主語をそのまま受動文の主語にする
byの後に目的格でない代名詞を置く
自動詞を目的語なしで受動化する

questions.prompt: All visitor badges ------- at the reception desk each morning.
questions.translationJa: すべての来訪者証は毎朝受付で発行されます。
questions.explanationJa: badgesが発行される対象なのでare issuedの受動態です。

questions.prompt: The damaged window ------- by a maintenance crew yesterday afternoon.
questions.translationJa: 破損した窓は昨日午後、保守班によって交換されました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の受動なのでwas＋過去分詞replacedです。

questions.prompt: The final report will ------- to all department heads on Monday.
questions.translationJa: 最終報告書は月曜日に全部門長へ送付されます。
questions.explanationJa: 助動詞willの後はbe＋過去分詞で受動態を作ります。

questions.prompt: The conference room is being ------- for the afternoon presentation.
questions.translationJa: 会議室は午後の発表に向けて準備中です。
questions.explanationJa: 進行中の受動はis being＋過去分詞preparedです。

questions.prompt: The new access code has already ------- to registered participants.
questions.translationJa: 新しいアクセスコードは登録参加者へすでに提供されました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了受動はhas been＋過去分詞givenです。

questions.prompt: The mural was designed ------- a local artist whose work appears in the lobby.
questions.translationJa: その壁画はロビーにも作品がある地元芸術家によってデザインされました。
questions.explanationJa: 重要な行為者を示す前置詞はbyです。

questions.prompt: The invoices ------- before payment can be authorized.
questions.translationJa: 支払いを承認する前に請求書を確認しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 助動詞mustの受動はmust be＋過去分詞です。

questions.prompt: The missing equipment was ------- in a storage closet on the third floor.
questions.translationJa: 紛失していた機器は3階の倉庫で見つかりました。
questions.explanationJa: findの過去分詞はfoundで、was foundが受動を作ります。

questions.prompt: The customer’s address was not ------- correctly on the shipping label.
questions.translationJa: 顧客の住所は配送ラベルに正しく書かれていませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: writeの過去分詞writtenをwas notの後に置きます。

questions.prompt: When ------- the safety guidelines last updated?
questions.translationJa: 安全指針が最後に更新されたのはいつですか。
questions.explanationJa: 複数主語guidelinesの過去受動疑問なのでwereを前置します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly focuses on the item receiving the action.

choices.A: The replacement parts delivered before noon.
choices.B: The replacement parts were deliver before noon.
choices.C: The replacement parts were delivering the courier before noon.
choices.D: The replacement parts were delivered before noon.

questions.translationJa: 交換部品は正午前に配達されました。
questions.explanationJa: 対象partsを主語にしwere＋過去分詞deliveredを使っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive version of “The technician repaired the scanner.”

choices.A: The technician was repaired by the scanner.
choices.B: The scanner was repaired by the technician.
choices.D: The scanner was repair by the technician.

questions.translationJa: スキャナーは技術者によって修理されました。
questions.explanationJa: 能動文の目的語scannerを主語へ移しwas repairedとしています。
questions.focus: 能動から受動への変換

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct irregular past participle.

choices.A: The access card was took from the desk.
choices.B: The access card taken was from the desk by.
choices.C: The access card was taken from the desk.
choices.D: The access card was taking from the desk.

questions.translationJa: アクセスカードは机から持ち去られました。
questions.explanationJa: takeの過去分詞はtakenなのでwas takenが正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly forms a passive question.

choices.A: Was the package inspected at the border?
choices.B: Did the package was inspected at the border?
choices.C: Was inspected the package at the border?
choices.D: The package was inspect at the border?

questions.translationJa: その荷物は国境で検査されましたか。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞Wasを主語の前に置き、過去分詞inspectedを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct negative passive form.

choices.A: The files did not deleted during the update.
choices.B: The files were not delete during the update.
choices.C: The files not were deleting during the update.
choices.D: The files were not deleted during the update.

questions.translationJa: ファイルは更新中に削除されませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: were not＋過去分詞deletedが過去受動の否定形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly adds an important agent.

choices.A: The award was presented from the company president.
choices.B: The award presented by the company president was.
choices.C: The award was presented by the company president.
choices.D: The company president was presented by the award.

questions.translationJa: 賞は社長によって授与されました。
questions.explanationJa: 行為者が重要なのでby the company presidentを加えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct future passive sentence.

choices.A: The results will announce at tomorrow’s meeting.
choices.B: The results will be announced at tomorrow’s meeting.
choices.C: The results will be announce at tomorrow’s meeting.
choices.D: The results will announced be tomorrow.

questions.translationJa: 結果は明日の会議で発表されます。
questions.explanationJa: will be＋過去分詞announcedが未来受動の形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that preserves the event in “A courier collected the samples.”

choices.A: A courier was collected by the samples.
choices.C: The samples were collecting by a courier.
choices.D: The samples were collected by a courier.

questions.translationJa: 試料は配達員によって回収されました。
questions.explanationJa: 対象samplesを主語へ移しても元の出来事と役割を保っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct present perfect passive sentence.

choices.A: The meeting schedule has changed by someone twice.
choices.B: The meeting schedule has been change twice.
choices.C: The meeting schedule has been changed twice.
choices.D: The meeting schedule is been changed twice.

questions.translationJa: 会議日程は2度変更されました。
questions.explanationJa: has been＋過去分詞changedが現在完了受動です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct ongoing passive form.

choices.A: The lobby is being renovated this week.
choices.B: The lobby is renovating this week.
choices.C: The lobby is been renovated this week.
choices.D: The lobby being is renovate this week.

questions.translationJa: ロビーは今週改装中です。
questions.explanationJa: is being＋過去分詞renovatedで進行中の受動を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager approved the request.”

choices.A: The request was approved by the manager.
choices.B: The manager was approved by the request.
choices.C: The request approved a different manager.
choices.D: No approval was given to the request.

questions.translationJa: 申請は管理者によって承認されました。
questions.explanationJa: 目的語requestを主語にした受動文でも出来事は同じです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The documents were copied before the meeting.”

choices.A: The documents copied someone after the meeting.
choices.B: Someone destroyed the documents before copying them.
choices.C: The meeting was copied by the documents.
choices.D: Someone copied the documents before the meeting.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが会議前に書類を複写しました。
questions.explanationJa: 行為者不明の受動文をsomeone主語の能動文へ戻しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “A local firm built the new warehouse.”

choices.A: The local firm was built inside the warehouse.
choices.B: The warehouse built a local firm.
choices.C: The new warehouse was built by a local firm.
choices.D: A new warehouse hired the local firm.

questions.translationJa: 新しい倉庫は地元企業によって建設されました。
questions.explanationJa: 能動の対象warehouseへ視点を移した同義の受動文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The package has been opened.”

choices.A: The package has opened another item.
choices.C: Someone will keep the package sealed.

questions.translationJa: 誰かがその荷物を開封しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了受動を不特定の行為者someoneを用いて能動化しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The staff will inspect every room.”

choices.A: Every room will be inspected by the staff.
choices.B: Every room will inspect the staff.
choices.C: The staff will be inspected by every room.
choices.D: No room will receive an inspection.

questions.translationJa: すべての部屋がスタッフによって検査されます。
questions.explanationJa: will inspectをwill be inspectedへ変えて対象を主語にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The password was written on the card.”

choices.A: The password wrote a card for someone.
choices.B: Someone erased every password from the card.
choices.C: Someone wrote the password on the card.
choices.D: The card was writing the password itself.

questions.translationJa: 誰かがカードにパスワードを書きました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去受動was writtenをsomeone主語の能動過去へ戻しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The storm damaged several signs.”

choices.B: The storm was damaged by signs.
choices.C: The signs prevented all storm damage.
choices.D: Several signs were damaged by the storm.

questions.translationJa: 複数の標識が嵐によって破損しました。
questions.explanationJa: 対象signsを主語にした受動文で因果関係を保っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The application is being reviewed.”

choices.A: Someone is reviewing the application now.
choices.B: The application is reviewing an employee.
choices.C: Someone completed the review long ago.
choices.D: The application will never receive a review.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが現在その申請を審査しています。
questions.explanationJa: is being reviewedは現在進行中の受動的な審査です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The committee chose three finalists.”

choices.B: Three finalists were chosen by the committee.
choices.C: The committee was chosen by three buildings.

questions.translationJa: 3人の最終候補者が委員会によって選ばれました。
questions.explanationJa: chooseの過去分詞chosenを用いて対象へ視点を移しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The equipment must be tested before use.”

choices.A: The equipment must test its users first.
choices.B: Testing is forbidden before the equipment is used.
choices.C: Someone must test the equipment before anyone uses it.
choices.D: Users must avoid testing all equipment.

questions.translationJa: 使用前に誰かが機器を試験しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: must be testedを不特定行為者の能動文へ展開しています。

questions.prompt: The reception area has new furniture. All chairs ------- by a local manufacturer.
questions.translationJa: 受付区域には新しい家具があります。すべての椅子は地元メーカーが製造しました。
questions.explanationJa: chairsが製造される対象なのでwere madeです。

questions.prompt: The online store received the order this morning. The item will ------- this afternoon.
questions.translationJa: オンライン店は今朝注文を受けました。商品は本日午後に発送されます。
questions.explanationJa: 未来受動will be shippedが文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: A pipe burst overnight. The water supply has ------- until repairs are complete.
questions.translationJa: 夜間に管が破裂しました。修理完了まで給水が停止されています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在までの結果をhas been stoppedで表します。

questions.prompt: The artist attended the opening ceremony. The main entrance mural was painted ------- her.
questions.translationJa: 芸術家は開会式に出席しました。正面入口の壁画は彼女が描きました。
questions.explanationJa: 前文で重要な行為者をby herで明示します。

questions.prompt: The maintenance team is still inside the elevator. It is being ------- now.
questions.translationJa: 保守チームはまだエレベーター内にいます。現在点検中です。
questions.explanationJa: 進行受動is being inspectedが適切です。

questions.prompt: No employee remembers moving the key. It may have been ------- accidentally.
questions.translationJa: 鍵を動かした記憶がある従業員はいません。誤って持ち去られた可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: may have beenの後にtakeの過去分詞takenを置きます。

questions.prompt: The board meets tomorrow morning. The proposal must be ------- before then.
questions.translationJa: 取締役会は明朝開かれます。それまでに提案書を書かなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: must beの後にwriteの過去分詞writtenが必要です。

questions.prompt: The alarm did not sound during the test. Was the battery ------- correctly?
questions.translationJa: 試験中に警報が鳴りませんでした。電池は正しく取り付けられていましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 受動疑問Was＋主語＋過去分詞を完成するinstalledです。

questions.prompt: The company posted the results online. They were also ------- to every applicant by email.
questions.translationJa: 会社は結果をオンライン掲載し、各応募者へメールでも送付しました。
questions.explanationJa: theyが送られる対象なのでwere sentです。

questions.prompt: The road is closed near the station. Drivers are being ------- to an alternate route.
questions.translationJa: 駅付近の道路は閉鎖されています。運転手は別経路へ案内されています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在進行受動are being directedが適切です。
